cases.purpose: Escalation status and shell continuation: preserve
cases.oracle: GNU timeout in the locked guest with identical child programs.
cases.comparison: Exact status and shell continuation; launcher diagnostics are captured separately.
cases.script:
{ timeout --preserve-status -k 0.2 0.6 /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import signal;signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN);signal.alarm(8);signal.pause()'; rc=$?; } 2> launcher-diagnostic
printf 'status=%s\ncontinued\n' "$rc"; rm -f launcher-diagnostic

cases.purpose: Initial signal exits before kill-after deadline
cases.oracle: GNU timeout in the locked guest with identical child programs.
cases.comparison: Exact status and shell continuation; launcher diagnostics are captured separately.
cases.script:
{ timeout -k 1 0.5 /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import signal,os;signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,lambda s,f:os._exit(7));signal.alarm(8);signal.pause()'; rc=$?; } 2> launcher-diagnostic
printf 'status=%s\ncontinued\n' "$rc"; rm -f launcher-diagnostic
